says: Last pass on this scene, taking all three notes. Boulders: the dashes are gone; each shadow stroke is now one continuous line, gone over again harder at its dark end so it tapers, and the strokes crowd together into a dark core at the lower right, with a band of stipple carrying the tone across the terminator into the light. The big butte loses its grid: long vertical fissures of uneven length, a notched caprock, and a single light diagonal hatch over the shadow face. The wanderer gets a firm dark contour, a solid black hood opening, a chest strap, a hip pouch and a zigzag hem. Small stones now dot the middle ground.
